scope: Three reported revision findings; original engine, backend structure, economy, artwork and hosting retained.

production.reason: Original Supabase URL/public key and authorized migration/Auth access are not supplied; existing public configuration is empty. No replacement backend or guessed values.

results.name: all four map durations, bosses and increasing HP are shared deterministic rules
all maps instantiate 30 matching enemies, correct bosses and exact appearance thresholds
forest enemies remain airborne, with visible windup and swoop states instead of burrowing
glacier, caldera and reef enemies fire only matching ice, fire and water attacks
elemental bosses have different timed volley, breath, slide and rush patterns
boss defeat advances maps automatically while ordinary enemies remain alive
victory cannot be cancelled by a lingering attack or a fall during the defeat animation
page exit during a boss celebration records completion once before the next visit
fruit and vegetables auto-collect on desktop, once, without any key
weapons stay on the ground until E, on desktop and touch; only nearest weapon is claimed
every offered weapon in the outer pickup range can be collected by one explicit action
one action takes the nearest eligible weapon even if a farther drop is processed first
growth triggers at every 20-point boundary and leaves collision dimensions/footing stable
SQK world size is exactly 70% of the prior dimensions, and defeat remains idempotent
each weapon dispatches its own sound and retains original damage and ammo rules
guest scores never become a global board and existing local data stays untouched
existing device volume and mute settings survive the upgrade
each weapon builds a distinct oscillator/sweep/envelope signature
the master compressor, conservative gain, per-effect rate limit and 24-voice ceiling bound overlap
SFX mute suppresses every weapon, and changing settings writes the original storage key

limitations: Graph/envelope checks use a Web Audio fixture. Speaker loudness and subjective listening have not been measured.

results.name: 006 and 007 preserve every profile, wallet, balance, inventory and historical score fingerprint
pre-upgrade pending events still settle once through the original v4 protocol
same verified wallet and concurrent profile opens return one original profile
unverified users, forged metadata and anonymous clients cannot create ranked profiles
acknowledged produce points checkpoint immediately and replay cannot double-credit
second-device start leaves the first run active; its own death settles points only once
all four SQL maps match their duration, enemy families, HP and boss-only progression
RLS and grants deny direct writes; event validators reject arbitrary totals, repeats and foreign runs
Top 100 is global, capped and ordered by permanent SQL totals without wallet disclosure
legacy ticket migration retains a verified server balance; existing wallet always wins
the delivered read-only owner verification SQL passes every permission and checkpoint assertion

limitations: Auth identity fixtures; no hosted Supabase/signature validation.
Single PostgreSQL connection; independent-connection lock contention not exercised.

results.name: client restores authoritative wallet profile and starts version-6 ranked play
lost network acknowledgement replays safely and lifetime score is saved during play
offline events survive refresh in per-run durable storage and sync without totals from the browser
malformed acknowledgement retains events and retry cannot increase an already committed score
switching wallets isolates pending queues, profiles and later acknowledgements
two tabs retain separate queues, and ended-map recovery keeps rejected events downloadable
a stale tab acknowledgement cannot erase a newer durable event from another tab
signed login binds host, URI, nonce and expiry, uses personal_sign only, and does not import local totals
an incompatible backend fails before asking for a signature, and a declined signature leaves the guest intact
secret API keys and service-role JWTs fail closed before a network or signing call
the leaderboard client reads only the Supabase public RPC, never local scores

limitations: Auth/token and transport fixtures; signatures are not cryptographically verified by this harness.

results.name: all four maps play through legal engine combat, pickups and automatic SQL-backed progression
score, SQK, produce growth, progression and purchased cosmetics survive refresh and reconnect
no test path submits a score total, and every accepted score comes through hf_progress

limitations: Position/time/Auth/HTTP fixtures. Actual damage, server validation, loot, scoring and save client execute unchanged.

results.name: 007 preserves populated records, pending legacy run, validator and RLS/grants
another device starting and saving cannot abandon an offline run or strand its actual fruit event
independent run retries and lost replies credit each source once into the shared lifetime ledger
another run finishing leaves a refreshed offline queue uploadable and both totals permanent
legacy starts preserve new devices while retaining legacy settlement and its single-active-run constraint
interleaved runs retain ownership, timing, ordered sequence, score and terminal checks

limitations: Auth, HTTP, position and time fixtures; actual engine/save/SQL functions.
Single PostgreSQL connection: interleaving tested, independent connection lock contention not exercised.

results.name: production export loads at a subpath with complete metadata and no console/resource errors
keyboard Tab reaches the game and Connect, and closing the wallet returns focus
entry and profile pass automated WCAG A/AA checks
desktop start, story, keyboard movement, jump, pause and resume work on the unmodified export
profile validation, wardrobe, audio settings and real unavailable-leaderboard state are usable
390-wide first screen includes game, Start and Connect with no horizontal overflow
phone start, rotate fallback, portrait opt-in and landscape resize preserve the run
all four worlds render their own scenery and bosses from the actual engine
touch weapon pickup requires a visible PICK UP action; walking near it alone does not claim it
one action owns one pointer; a second press cannot release the first held action
growth is visible at 20 and 40 points with unchanged collision body
rendered map progression is automatic and final boss reaches the ending
320-wide modal and entry layout stays within viewport
390-wide modal and entry layout stays within viewport
1440-wide modal and entry layout stays within viewport
200% text and an RTL mirror keep the primary controls and dialogs usable
no runtime errors occurred during production and instrumented flows

limitations: WebKit could not launch: missing system libraries (GTK4, GStreamer and related WebKit runtime dependencies). No Safari interaction result is claimed.

results.name: EIP-6963 MetaMask connects, switches network and signs an explicit gas-free login
real engine produce events save through HTTP/RPC and the lifetime HUD updates during play
leaderboard displays SQL rankings and a transport failure retains them with a working retry
marketplace purchase and equip preserve a permanent SQK balance and inventory
refresh silently restores the same signed wallet profile, score and cosmetics without a new signature
a second device signing the same wallet retrieves one existing profile and permanent records
disconnect switches the title and profile back to the guest without exposing wallet records
wallet/cloud browser flows produce no JavaScript or unexpected database errors

limitations: Wallet provider, signatures, Auth and HTTP are fixtures. Database RPCs and rendered game/UI are real. No hosted Supabase or real MetaMask signing is proven.

results.name: touch PICK UP succeeds at the reported 24-pixel outer range without stepping closer
desktop E claims the offered weapon at the same outer range
mouse weapon selection returns focus to gameplay and Space jumps while Enter fires
deliberate keyboard activation retains slot focus and native Enter/Space toggling
touch weapon slot selection returns focus to the canvas
two 390-wide devices save both real fruit events after A goes offline and B starts a new run
retry, browser refresh and a fresh SQL leaderboard retain exactly both points without duplicates
final revision flows have no JavaScript or unexpected local/SQL resource failures

limitations: WebKit cannot launch: missing GTK4, GStreamer and related host libraries; no Safari result claimed.
Auth sessions, HTTP and deterministic position/frame access are fixtures; game/save/UI/SQL are real. No hosted Supabase or physical device proof.

results.name: 004 reproduces the real-identity failure before the upgrade
005 upgrades without rewriting identities, profile links, balances, purchases or history
uppercase verified claims and a different Auth UUID reopen the same unique profile
flat claims, wrong provider/chain, malformed addresses and editable metadata do not authenticate
nested claims take precedence over contradictory top-level address fields
owned ended-run state returns the exact acknowledgement and settled authoritative profile
another wallet and anonymous clients cannot inspect or recover someone else’s run
post-upgrade preservation and permission checks run as SQL

suites.limitations: Fixture Auth rows; no hosted Supabase login.

results.name: 004 and 005 apply over populated 003 without changing profile fields, wallet links or historical daily scores
an old active run settles only new points beyond its already-credited migration baseline
completed session replay cannot credit lifetime points again
new score events after a session ended are rejected
fresh in-progress map score remains separate from the lifetime total
restarting or moving to another device settles an abandoned session exactly once
smaller sessions add to the lifetime total instead of replacing a previous best
the same verified address under a different Auth UUID resolves the original profile
the public board and compatibility reader rank preserved lifetime totals only
changing old calendar buckets or the clock cannot hide the lifetime ranking
removed daily ranking RPC is no longer callable
no replacement for the old daily reset writes remains in the current progress RPC
lifetime totals cannot be accidentally reduced even by an ordinary owner SQL update
profile deletion cannot cascade away permanent scores
browser clients cannot update balances or lifetime totals directly
browser clients cannot insert lifetime ledger entries
unverified users cannot call hf_wallet_profile
unverified users cannot call hf_start_run_v4
unverified users cannot call hf_purchase
unverified users cannot call hf_equip
another wallet cannot submit events to the original wallet’s run
purchase retries deduct SQK once and owned costumes use the same equip/unequip RPC
arbitrary browser-supplied lifetime totals are rejected
pickup acknowledgements remain idempotent and give SQK without counting it as score
a new sequence cannot claim the same SQK drop twice
an entire legal map completion credits all points once and keeps progression and balance
Top 100 is capped, deterministic on ties and excludes anonymous historical profiles

suites.limitations: Fixture Auth; no hosted Supabase project or real signatures.
